answer_1.quote: This work reformulates dialog state tracking as a conversational semantic parsing task to overcome the limitations of slot filling.
answer_1.outputs: structured dialog states represented as rooted relational graphs

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we measure turn-level dialog state exact match accuracy averaged over all turns in the test set.

answer_4.quote: After the task, we ask a different batch of annotators to evaluate if each human-generated utterance preserves the meaning of the templated utterance; any conversation that fails this check is removed.
answer_4.guideline: evaluate if each human-generated utterance preserves the meaning of the templated utterance
